summary: VS ELEMENT AS (org. no. 976 758 218) is a private limited company (AS) based in Tønsberg, in the Brønnøysund registers since 1996-09-26. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 23.610 (Produksjon av betongprodukter for bygge- og anleggsvirksomhet); it has 27 registered employees. In its 2025 accounts (company level) operating revenue was NOK 60.6 m and net income was NOK 4.9 m. CEO: Runar Haug; board chair: Runar Haug; auditor: REVISJONSFIRMAET ÅSVANG & CO AS.
